_description: Reviewed allowlist for Alexandria-derived Learn resources. The importer may generate candidates, but only these source UUIDs are publishable.

resources.title: Couples Meditation and Co-Regulation
resources.subtitle: Research support for shared practice
resources.summary: A peer-reviewed research summary covering mindfulness-based relationship enhancement, dyadic meditation, inter-brain synchrony, cardiac co-regulation, and compassion training.
resources.reflection_prompt: Where do you notice regulation becoming easier when it is shared with another person?

resources.title: Meditation Neuroscience: Richard Davidson
resources.subtitle: Awareness, connection, insight, and purpose
resources.summary: A research reference on Richard Davidson's meditation neuroscience and the four pillars of wellbeing that connect self-regulation to agency.
resources.reflection_prompt: Which pillar feels most available today: awareness, connection, insight, or purpose?

resources.title: Russell Consciousness Theory and Meditation
resources.subtitle: A philosophical bridge for practice
resources.summary: A Dharma integration note mapping meditation, breath, binaural beats, body awareness, and deep states to Walter Russell's octave model.
resources.reflection_prompt: What changes when you imagine practice as moving toward balance rather than fixing yourself?

resources.title: Light and Consciousness
resources.subtitle: Russell's core insight
resources.summary: A concise philosophical note on Russell's inversion of materialist assumptions and its relevance to agency and purpose.
resources.reflection_prompt: Where do you experience yourself as more than the pressure of the current moment?

resources.title: The Water Method
resources.subtitle: A subconscious programming practice guide
resources.summary: A reviewed practice guide using water as a physical ritual anchor for intention, visualization, and identity work.
resources.reflection_prompt: What small physical ritual could help you remember the person you are practicing becoming?

resources.title: MBCT for Couples and Relationship Systems
resources.subtitle: Clinical applications for relational practice
resources.summary: A longer clinical research guide. For v1, POW publishes metadata and summary only; full document review is deferred.
resources.reflection_prompt: What relationship pattern becomes easier to notice when you slow down before reacting?

resources.title: The Power of Awareness
resources.subtitle: Neville Goddard source reference
resources.summary: A source reference for agency and identity work. Because rights and formatting need separate review, v1 exposes metadata only.
resources.reflection_prompt: What assumption about yourself are you ready to test gently in practice?
